description_en: Adds features to the Thing Specification Language (TSL) model of a specified product, with support for adding extended descriptions of the TSL model at the same time
description_zh: 为指定产品的物模型新增功能，支持同时新增物模型扩展描述
name: CreateThingModel

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product. This is the globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the product.

You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
产品的ProductKey，物联网平台为产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html接口，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The details of the features to add. You can include the definitions of up to 10 features.

In each property structure of ThingModelJson, you can use extendConfig to describe the extended TSL model data. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150457.html.

<notice>The ThingModelJson parameter does not accept complete TSL data. Specify only the properties, services, and events fields in JSON format.
</notice>

The following example shows property data that contains multiple data types, such as STRUCT and ARRAY.
```
{
  "properties": [
    {
      "custom": true,
      "dataSpecsList": [
        {
          "childDataType": "TEXT",
          "childName": "Device SIM card CCID",
          "dataSpecs": {
            "custom": true,
            "dataType": "TEXT",
            "length": 20
          },
          "dataType": "STRUCT",
          "identifier": "CCID",
          "name": "Device SIM card CCID"
        },
        {
          "childDataType": "INT",
          "childName": "Battery level",
          "dataSpecs": {
            "custom": true,
            "dataType": "INT",
            "max": "60000",
            "min": "0",
            "step": "1"
          },
          "dataType": "STRUCT",
          "identifier": "battery",
          "name": "Battery level"
        },
        {
          "childDataType": "TEXT",
          "childName": "Other information",
          "dataSpecs": {
            "custom": true,
            "dataType": "TEXT",
            "length": 1024
          },
          "dataType": "STRUCT",
          "identifier": "other_info",
          "name": "Other information"
        }
      ],
      "dataType": "STRUCT",
      "identifier": "DEV_INFO",
      "name": "Device information",
      "productKey": "a1T***",
      "propertyId": 18786548,
      "required": false,
      "rwFlag": "READ_ONLY"
    },
    {
      "custom": true,
      "dataSpecs": {
        "childDataType": "INT",
        "custom": true,
        "dataType": "ARRAY",
        "size": 1,
        "dataSpecs": {
          "custom": true,
          "dataType": "INT",
          "max": "65535",
          "min": "0",
          "step": "1",
          "unit": "ppm",
          "unitName": "parts per million"
        }
      },
      "dataType": "ARRAY",
      "identifier": "airRH_SR",
      "name": "Dehumidifier humidity",
      "productKey": "a1T***",
      "propertyId": 18786551,
      "required": false,
      "rwFlag": "READ_ONLY"
    }
  ],
  "services": [...],
  "events": [...]
}
```
parameters.help_zh:

</notice>

parameters.name: thing_model_json

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier must be unique within the product. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot exceed 30 characters in length.

This parameter must be used together with FunctionBlockName. If you do not specify this parameter, the features are added to the default module
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。支持英文大小写字母、数字和下划线（_），不超过30个字符。

需与FunctionBlockName结合使用。不传入此参数时，新增功能导入默认模块
parameters.name: function_block_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character or a Japanese character counts as one character.

This parameter must be used together with FunctionBlockId. If you do not specify this parameter, the features are added to the default module
parameters.help_zh:
物模型的自定义模块名称。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字和下划线（_），长度限制为4～30个字符，一个中文、一个日文算1个字符。

需与FunctionBlockId结合使用。不传入此参数时，新增功能导入默认模块
parameters.name: function_block_name
